summary: Held through a healthy run to a +33.5pt peak, tolerating normal chop and giveback along the way since PROPP-with kept confirming and giveback never exceeded ~40% of the live leg. Exited at +2.5pts when price violently round-tripped almost the entire favorable move in one frame (32pt adverse leg, 0% recovered) with all three fire signals (KMDR, HA, PROPP) simultaneously against for the first time in the episode - that triple-against confluence on a fresh full-amplitude adverse leg was the exit trigger. Next time I'd watch for that same triple-against + fresh-leg-zero-recovery combo earlier as a hard trailing-stop signal rather than waiting for confirmation, since by the time it fired here more than 2/3 of peak profit was already gone.
